Every company is driven by IT. Developments emerge in rapid succession; today we're moving everything to the cloud, and data science and AI are indispensable. Good IT professionals are needed to really get a handle on these developments. We want the best IT employee for your organisation, to help you expand your IT knowledge and become a leader in market developments.

No need to explain to us that Java has nothing to do with JavaScript, .NET is not a programming language and Puppet is an open-source software configuration management tool. We understand what you're looking for. We have and continually acquire in-house IT knowledge. Our work is guided by knowledge and, where necessary, we provide advice. For example, would you like to know what the ICT job market is like at the moment?

Sharing knowledge is our passion. In partnership with the IT community, we strive for technical and personal development alike. That's why we regularly organise a Tech Talk for you and your colleagues.

Whether it concerns permanent jobs or temporary assignments, we provide 'the best match'. It's with good reason that we employ 90 IT Resource Consultants: we can pay true attention to your position!

iSense won the Computable Award 'ICT secondment service of the Year' in 2012, 2013, 2014, 2015 and 2016: five consecutive years! We're enormously proud of this!

We have our own training platform with over 1,500 courses and work closely with one of the largest IT trainers. We provide everyone the opportunity to further develop themselves, both professionaly and personally.

Every placement involves customisation. In practice, this means you avoid getting sixteen CVs on your desk and your IT staff do not have IT vacancies thrown in their lap. It does, however, mean engaging in a good conversation to really map out your needs. And with success, on average, one in three of the proposed professionals is actually placed.

In nearly 20 years, iSense has built up a network of more than 100,000 IT professionals. We're constantly working to expand this network so that we can always adequately respond to your requests.

Knowledge of the local and regional market is essential. That's why we work in regions, so you can be sure that you're speaking to someone who operates in your environment daily.

AWEN Engineering Services S.L. is a Company founded in 2014 by professionals with more than 15 year of experience in the military and aerospace business. The main purpose of the company is providing services in the scope of testing engineering to companies in the aforementioned sectors.

From its foundation, AWEN has growth and increased the customer portfolio. Currently AWEN makes business in a recurrent way with several first level national and international companies in the military and aerospace sectors.

The following is a summary of the services provided by AWEN:
• Design, manufacturing and test of GSEs (Ground Support Equipment) including the integration in the customer facilities. Amongst other it can be mentioned the following products: LISNs (Line Impedance Simulation Network), UTs (Unit Tester) and Power control boxes.
• Design, manufacturing and test of vacuum and ambient test harnesses. Automated testing of isolation and continuity. Process following the standard IPC/WHMA-A-620 Requirements and Acceptance for Cable and Wire Harness Assemblies.
• Design, manufacturing, assembly and repair of PCBs (Printed Circuits Boards) in insertion (through-hole) and SMD technologies. Process following the standard IPC/WHMA-A-610 Acceptability of Electronic Assemblies.
• Engineering support: design office for mechanical drawings, harness drawings, complete documentation set for units, etc.
• Design and manufacturing of mechanical parts (small pieces, panels, etc.).
• Purchasing management.
• Design and development of embedded Software.

entityDescription: The National Research Council (Cnr) is the largest public research institution in Italy, the only one under the Research Ministry performing multidisciplinary activities. In the Cnr's research world, the main resource is the available knowledge which means people, with their skills, commitment and ideas. This capital comprises more than 8.000 employees, of whom more than half are researchers and technologists. Some 4.000 young researchers are engaged in postgraduate studies and research training at Cnr within the organization’s top-priority areas of interest. A significant contribution also comes from research associates: researchers, from Universities or private firms, who take part in Cnr’s research activities.

entityDescription:
IDAF is an Advanced Agro-Forestry Consulting SME. Its mission is the generation and transfer of knowledge and innovation to the forestry sector, be it public or private, from small initiatives to large companies. The business activity of the company is approached from four different areas of work: international cooperation, applied research, advanced consulting and specialized training. 
IDAF S.L applies innovation to the forestry sector in order to provide solutions to real problems and thus promote sustainable development mainly through the evaluation of natural resources using new technologies.
IDAF has a solid and reliable experience in forest management with more than 10 years of experience, out of the total 170,000 ha assessed by IDAF, 45,467,620 ha have been evaluated using technological equipment. IDAF has developed more than 45 projects of advanced consultancy, innovation and technological projects with great technical solvency for different types of clients such as private companies and corporations, universities, public institutions. IDAF has mainly developed its activity in the international area, specifically in Spain and Portugal, in Latin America: Chile, Uruguay, Bolivia and Peru. In Africa: Morocco, Mozambique, Angola, Guinea Bissau, Cape Verde and in Asia: Lebanon and Russia.

entityName: ARPA Puglia - AGENZIA REGIONALE PER LA PREVENZIONE E LA PROTEZIONE AMBIENTALE PUGLIA
entityDescription:
The Regional Agency for the Environmental Prevention and Protection (ARPA Puglia) is the official monitoring authority for Apulia Region in environment management. It is responsible for the monitoring of surface water bodies (Water Framework Directive),
marine waters (Marine Strategy Framework Directive) and bathing waters (Bathing Water Directive) in the Region. ARPA is the regional reference centre for the environmental control of the coastal marine ecosystem, with good international linkages with Countries of the Adriatic coasts. It participated into several research programs on marine pollution and ecology and institutional programs to support the ecosystem and biodiversity safeguard, besides developing plans and projects for the improvement, environmental protection and integrated management of the marine costal area. ARPA is also involved in educational programs contributing to dissemination of knowledge of marine environment and campaigns for increase of public awareness.
ARPA Puglia is involved in control activities on chemical, biological and physical risk factors which could affect all environmental matrices also with the aim at preventing harmful effects for human beings and for the sustainable territorial management. The staff of the Agency actually consists of more than 380 employees (scientific, technical and administrative). The Agency includes the Direction (located in Bari) and six local Departments called DAPs (Bari, Barletta-Andria-Trani, Brindisi, Foggia, Lecce and Taranto).

entityDescription: Statsat AS was established in 2013 as a wholly owned subsidiary of Space Norway AS. The company is established to provide services to government agencies within expanded self-government. This means that the state, through the Ministry of Trade and Industry (NFD), which owns Space Norway AS, through its ownership and control of the company and through the statutes for the two companies, has a continuous control in Statsat AS. The NFD shall, among other things, approve the tasks Statsat takes for state entities. The statutes specify that "the company can only provide services to persons other than such government entities or its shareholders to a very limited extent". Services to non-governmental entities are limited to a certain proportion of turnover, in order for Statsat not to act as a commercial company. As of 2017, this share has been set at 20% in accordance with Norwegian and European rules for companies with extended self-registration.

- Networking
- Software 
- Knowledge
- High Performance Computing
- Visual 
- Flight and Structural Mechanics

and dynamic interactions take place among different areas, giving rise to fruitful
cross-fertilization.

 
The research staff is organized into 12 laboratories, each having a wide
 scientific and administrative autonomy; the members of the research 
staff are normally involved in one or more of these units. 

"Curiosity driven" and independent research are also encouraged and supported.



Research Laboratories pursue a well-defined set of strongly related scientific objectives.
In addition to research, objectives may also cover technology development and training.
The teams include permanent staff, visitors, post-doctoral fellows and doctoral students, with an
average number of 10 members per Lab.

entityName: Fundación para la Investigación Biomédica del Hospital Universitario La Paz
entityDescription:
FIBHULP is the managing entity for all research involvement of IdiPAZ and La Paz Univiersity Hospital (HULP) staff. HULP is the referral hospital for an area with a population of 750,000. This prestigious hospital is widely recognised for its range of specialisations such as oncology, haematology, immunology and infectious diseases (HIV), hepatology, cardiology, paediatrics and neonatology, neurology and neurodegenerative diseases, digestive diseases and nutrition, rheumatology, ophthalmology, maxillofacial, surgery and trauma.
IdiPAZ concentrates the clinical, translational and experimental research of the La Paz University Hospital. The institute harbours 55 research groups distributed in six main research areas: neurosciences; cardiovascular; infectious diseases and immunity; organ system pathologies; cancer and human molecular genetics; and surgery, transplant and health technologies. The administrative organization that takes care of the Hospital and Institute research activities is the FIBHULP (the biomedical research foundation of HULP).
